title: Cute Gingerbread House Christmas Clipart
author: Arohi Studio
description:
Bring sweet holiday charm to your creative projects with this Cute Gingerbread House Christmas Clipart Bundle. Featuring adorable gingerbread houses decorated with pink candy roof tiles, white icing, colorful round candies, pink bows, candy canes, and snowy details, this festive illustration captures the magic of a whimsical Christmas candy house.
These charming gingerbread house designs feature pink doors, decorated windows, brick chimneys, peppermint candies, snowy rooftops, and delicate winter decorations. The soft pink, white, brown, and pastel colors make this clipart perfect for Christmas crafts, holiday greeting cards, stickers, invitations, gift tags, sublimation designs, mugs, T-shirts, scrapbook pages, and other festive DIY projects.
Product Details
– Included: 36 PNG files
– Format: PNG
– Background: Transparent
– Resolution: 300 DPI
– Theme: Gingerbread House, Christmas, Candy House
– Style: Cute Cartoon, Whimsical Christmas Illustration
– Main Elements: Gingerbread houses, pink candy roofs, white icing, pink bows, candy canes, peppermint candies, snowy ground, windows, doors, chimneys, and colorful sweets
– Colors: Pink, white, brown, pastel blue, and red
Add a magical candy-themed touch to your Christmas creations with these adorable gingerbread house illustrations, perfect for festive decorations and sweet holiday designs.
